figs.cap: Schematics of a circuit associated with a local magnetization on the triangles (dashed lines represent the interactions, double-arrows the fluctuating spins, blue/red dots the orientation of bias). We highlighted what we called horizontal interactions.

A magnetic NAND gate (left) and NOR gate (right) built from antiferromagnetically interacting moments, and their truth table in Boolean algebra and their realization through antiferromagnetic spins. In red we have the input spins, in green the output. The blue spin is needed to bias frustration and changes the plaquette from a NAND to a NOR, making the gate re-programmable.
A spin-circuit to solve the Fibonacci sequence.
